:::{#exm-tautology}
#### $P \lor \neg P$ is a tautology
<!-- no-figure: the truth table is the display -->

By the definitions of [or](#def-or) and [not](#def-not),
the [truth table](#def-truth-table) of $P \lor \neg P$ is:

| $P$ | $\neg P$ | $P \lor \neg P$ |
|:---:|:--------:|:---------------:|
| T   | F        | T               |
| F   | T        | T               |

The last column is true in every row,
so $P \lor \neg P$ is a [tautology](#def-tautology).

:::
